course.title: Hydraulic Engineering
course.department: Department of Civil Engineering, CHRIST (Deemed to be University), Kengeri Campus
course.prereqs: Engineering Physics, Engineering Mathematics, Fluid Mechanics (CE204)

textbooks.cite: P. N. Modi and S. M. Seth, 'Hydraulics and Fluid Mechanics Including Hydraulics Machines', Standard Book House, New Delhi, 22nd ed., 2022.
R. K. Bansal, 'A Textbook of Fluid Mechanics and Hydraulic Machines', Laxmi Publications, New Delhi, 10th ed., 2021.
Ven Te Chow, 'Open-Channel Hydraulics', McGraw-Hill, New York (reprinted by Blackburn Press), 1959/2009.

references.cite: K. Subramanya, 'Flow in Open Channels', McGraw-Hill Education (India), 5th ed., 2019.
M. Hanif Chaudhry, 'Open-Channel Flow', Springer, 2nd ed., 2008.
H. K. Versteeg and W. Malalasekera, 'An Introduction to Computational Fluid Dynamics: The Finite Volume Method', Pearson, 2nd ed., 2007.

units.title: Boundary Layer Theory
units.syllabus: Physical concepts of boundary layer; laminar and turbulent boundary layer; boundary layer thickness; displacement, momentum and energy thickness; boundary layer over flat plate; von Kármán momentum integral equation; skin friction drag and boundary layer separation; cavitation.

units.title: Open Channel Flow
units.syllabus: Difference between pipe and open channel flow; types of open channels and geometric elements; Chezy and Manning equations; most economical channel sections (rectangular, trapezoidal, triangular); specific energy concept and critical depth; channel transitions and critical flow analysis; hydraulic jump: types, characteristics and energy dissipation; GVF and RVF overview.

units.title: Impact of Jets
units.syllabus: Dynamic action of fluid jet; impulse-momentum principle; force exerted on stationary flat and curved plates (normal and inclined); force on moving flat and curved plates; series of vanes; jet propulsion of ships; work done, power and hydraulic efficiency of jet action.

units.title: Hydraulic Machines: Turbines and Pumps
units.syllabus: Classification of hydraulic machines; impulse turbines (Pelton wheel): component parts, velocity triangles, work done, efficiency, design principles; reaction turbines (Francis and Kaplan): working principles, velocity diagrams, draft tube theory, cavitation; centrifugal pumps: working principle, work done, manometric head, efficiencies, minimum starting speed, multistage pumps, specific speed, cavitation.

units.title: Computational Hydraulics & 2D Hydrodynamic Modeling
units.syllabus: Introduction to Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) in hydraulic engineering; governing equations: Navier-Stokes and shallow water equations (SWE); 2D hydrodynamic modeling of open channels; grid generation and boundary conditions; Courant-Friedrichs-Lewy (CFL) stability criterion; SimFlow/OpenFOAM CFD modeling of hydraulic structures; HEC-RAS 2D unsteady flow modeling; inundation mapping, depth and velocity validation.

pages.title: Software setup
pages.hook: Install HEC-RAS 2D and SimFlow CFD before starting the computational lab track.

pages.title: Project (PBL)
pages.hook: Design a flood diversion channel, spillway energy dissipator, and 2D hydraulic simulation model.

pages.title: Assessment
pages.hook: Continuous Internal Assessment (CIA), mid-term examinations, end-semester evaluation, and lab rubrics.

pages.title: References
pages.hook: Standard textbooks, design handbooks, USACE engineering manuals, and IS codes.

software.title: About HEC-RAS 2D
software.when: UNIT II & V · LABS L06–L07, L13–L15
software.hook: US Army Corps of Engineers 1D/2D river hydraulics and hydrodynamic modeling software.

software.title: About SimFlow CFD
software.when: UNIT I, III, V · LABS L02, L08, L12
software.hook: Modern OpenFOAM GUI for multiphase VOF, free-surface hydraulics, and turbulent flow modeling.

software.title: Spreadsheets & Python
software.hook: Rapid numerical computation, normal depth solving, specific energy curves, and velocity triangles.

labs.title: Verification of Boundary Layer Velocity Profiles
labs.goal: Measure laminar and turbulent boundary layer profiles and compute displacement and momentum thicknesses.

labs.title: Flow Visualization & Boundary Layer Separation
labs.goal: Observe flow separation past bluff bodies, airfoils and adverse pressure gradients in a flow channel.

labs.title: Cavitation Inception in a Venturi / Orifice
labs.goal: Determine critical pressure drop, Thoma cavitation factor, and noise/vibration inception in restricted conduit flow.

labs.title: Uniform Flow & Manning's Roughness Determination
labs.goal: Measure normal depth at varying discharges in a tilting flume and calculate Manning's n and Chezy's C.

labs.title: Specific Energy & Critical Depth Verification
labs.goal: Construct specific energy curve experimentally and verify critical depth over a broad-crested weir and hump.

labs.title: Hydraulic Jump & Energy Dissipation
labs.goal: Form hydraulic jumps in a laboratory flume, measure conjugate depths, and compare head loss against Bélanger's equation.

labs.title: Gradually Varied Flow (GVF) Water Surface Profiles
labs.goal: Compute and measure M1 and M2 backwater profiles using the Standard Step Method and compare with HEC-RAS 1D.

labs.title: Impact of Jet on Flat & Curved Vanes
labs.goal: Measure hydrodynamic impact force exerted by water jet on stationary flat plate, hemispherical cup and 60° curved vane.

labs.title: Momentum Analysis of Moving Vanes & Series of Vanes
labs.goal: Determine mechanical power and hydrodynamic efficiency of moving vane assembly and compare with momentum theory.

labs.title: Performance Characteristics of Pelton Turbine
labs.goal: Operate a Pelton wheel test rig at constant head and variable speed; plot unit power, unit speed and efficiency curves.

labs.title: Performance Characteristics of Francis / Kaplan Turbine
labs.goal: Determine operating characteristics and efficiency curves of reaction turbine at various guide vane openings.

labs.title: Operating Characteristics of Centrifugal Pump
labs.goal: Measure total head, flow rate and shaft power; establish H-Q curve, efficiency curve, and best efficiency point (BEP).

labs.title: HEC-RAS 2D Mesh Generation & Terrain Setup
labs.goal: Create a 2D computation mesh in RAS Mapper, enforce breaklines along channel banks, and set Manning n regions.

labs.title: HEC-RAS 2D Unsteady Flow & Flood Inundation
labs.goal: Simulate unsteady hydrograph routing through a 2D channel; check CFL condition and map maximum flood inundation.

labs.title: SimFlow/OpenFOAM CFD Modeling of Hydraulic Structure
labs.goal: Set up 2D/3D numerical simulation of flow over a spillway or through a sluice gate and validate free-surface profile.
